title: Summary of the hydrology of the southeastern coastal plain aquifer system in Mississippi, Alabama, Georgia, and South Carolina
citation: Miller, J.A., 1992, Summary of the hydrology of the southeastern coastal plain aquifer system in Mississippi, Alabama, Georgia, and South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Professional Paper 1410-A, map scale 1:8,571,000.
notes: Regional summary (Mississippi, Alabama, Georgia, South Carolina); only South Carolina statements and system-wide statements that include South Carolina recorded. Plate 1 correlation chart and figure 14 (subregional units by State) OCR is garbled; South Carolina column not legible; not recorded. Simulated values (water budgets, calibrated transmissivity and leakance, simulated heads) not recorded. Potentiometric maps (figs. 7-9) are head maps with no legible South Carolina values. Hydrographs and geochemistry figures are outside South Carolina.
